description: Create a face collection (for example one per event). Creating one that already exists and is active succeeds without change; one that is being deleted or was deleted returns 409 (use restore_collection or recreate_collection). Indexing into a missing collection also creates it, so this is optional. Free.

collection_id.description: Collection id, e.g. an event or album id. Any text except '/', '\', '.' and '..'.

name: create_collection
title: Create a collection
